item: omnibar keyword group seeks the term index (range predicate instead of LIKE scan)
summary: The keyword group of /api/search/omni used normalized_term LIKE 'p%' ESCAPE, a full scan of the keyword table on SQLite (45 ms flat at 400k keywords, every keystroke). It now uses the range >= p AND < p+1 (30 ms for 1 character, 5.7 ms for 2, 1-3 ms from 3, measured at 400k keywords). Same rows as the LIKE prefix (pinned by a parametrized equivalence test incl. % and _ and non-ASCII), the plan test fails if the LIKE form returns; an empty or max-codepoint prefix keeps LIKE.
